# Files served as they are

boa pages load nothing from other websites, so the Worker serves these itself under `/_boa/`.

| File | What | From | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alpine.client.js` | Alpine.js 3.17.5 (`dist/cdn.min.js`) | npm `alpinejs` | MIT |
| `gowun-batang-400.woff2`, `gowun-batang-700.woff2` | Gowun Batang, Latin subset | npm `@fontsource/gowun-batang` 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 (`LICENSE-gowun-batang.txt`) |
| `inter.woff2` | Inter variable, Latin subset | npm `@fontsource-variable/inter` 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 (`LICENSE-inter.txt`) |
